4K treehouse rain with calm Minecraft music and distant thunder, no ads (10 hours)
description: Rain outside a treehouse one autumn evening, with calm Minecraft music and a storm passing in the distance. 10 hours, to sleep to or keep on while you work or study.
Most of the lightning is far off, with a low rumble a few seconds later. The cat on the cushion sleeps through all of it.
It's meant for the background, but if you look up now and then, these happen every hour:
1:37 the closest strike, under a kilometer away. Count the seconds to the thunder
3:34 another strike, and the cat's ears twitch when the thunder gets there
7:04 a gust shakes some leaves loose
8:45 a lantern boat comes down the river out of the mist
11:58 a heron flies past the mountains
21:10 the boat heads back up the river into the mist
